critical_code_review_comments: architecture_routes.py is clean and well-structured. RBAC correctly applied via require_role(['developer','executive']) on POST /regenerate, while GETs use plain get_current_user.
Short-circuit on unchanged content_hash avoids unnecessary DB writes and changelog pollution — good optimization.
Housekeeping keeps last 20 snapshots (count_documents then delete_many) — uses _id which is pymongo ObjectId, correct.
Both /history and /changelog use pagination_utils.paginated_response() consistently with the rest of the app (iteration 47 refactor).
Snapshot content_hash persists across requests, and second regenerate within same code state correctly returns status=unchanged (verified via test_regenerate_twice_unchanged).
Antipatterns auto-detected (7 multi-layer writes) are legitimate per agent context — each entry has required {severity,type,description,collection} fields.
ProtectedRoute allowedRoles=['developer','executive'] properly redirects coordinator/agent to / with 'Sin permisos' toast — verified live.
Sidebar visibility correctly gated by role — coordinator/agent do not see 'Arquitectura' entry.
